description: Land Acquisition - Wekanda, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District - Slave Island, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District - Galle Face, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific land lots for public purposes, including property descriptions, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), this is only in his capacity as the authority making the declaration under the land acquisition legislation, not as a government personnel or structural matter. The core content is exclusively about land/property acquisition, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
